label: The eigenspace of an eigenvalue
subgoals: Write the eigenspace as a null space.
Find a basis by solving a homogeneous system.
Explain why the eigenspace is a subspace.

label: Geometric multiplicity
subgoals: Compute the dimension of an eigenspace.
Relate it to the rank of the shifted matrix.
Show that it is at least one for a true eigenvalue.

label: Algebraic versus geometric multiplicity
subgoals: Read algebraic multiplicity from the characteristic polynomial.
